equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension is analyzed; groups are provider type, region, years in practice and caseload. Access to care appears only in one interpretive Discussion sentence about patients.

level_alternative.reason: The Discussion notes delayed diagnosis disadvantages patients who face challenges seeking care or lack access to specialists, which could count as equity raised only as an implication.

notes: The composite knowledge score (0–3) is a sum of correct answers, not a procedure. Design inferred as cross-sectional from the web-based survey; the report names it only as a survey. The 'inverse relationship' between knowledge and caseload rests on per-level chi-square p-values vs the 1–5 group; no trend test is reported.
view_issues: Table 1: 'Not too confident' 35.3% has CI 32.9–33.7, which excludes the estimate; resource rows labelled n=865 use 1,500 as denominator (955 = 63.7%); '>5' overlaps the 6–19, 20–100 and >100 rows; practice-site percentages (974 = 65.9%) do not match 1,500.
